title: mqttiumd trace record
description: One line of a JSON Lines trace: header, versioned record or footer (DEM-016). Each kind is stated by one origin only; hidden store truth and the inputs the core consumed never share an origin (ADR 0003). The digest of the trace lives in the external artifact inventory, never inside the trace.

perimeter.description: What a run exercises. `full`: client bytes through the transport, with independent peers. `core-without-bytes`: the core is driven with validated packets; no transport and no peer observes anything.

reason.description: The outcome the frame carries, in the vocabulary of the subset. A PUBREC that refuses an admission carries QuotaExceeded when a capacity is the cause and ImplementationSpecificError otherwise.

reason_code.description: The reason code the peer decoded; 0 when the packet omits it.

recovered_fact.description: One fact of a recovery page, as the store adapter reads it from the store the broker opened. The semantic pass enforces the order of the facts of a page: Epoch, Limits, RouteTable, Route, Session, InboundExchange, Operation.

then.description: The bounds the core needs to refuse before any mutation. Every bound is a decimal string; the two 32-bit ones are bounded by the semantic pass.
The durable revision of the route table. The routes that follow belong to it.
One target of one exact topic. Routes are sorted by the bytes of their topic.

opening_attempt.description: The identity of an opening attempt: the nonce its start-up drew and its number there.

StoreResultHandedOver.description: The result the store adapter hands over towards the core: the content of the result the store produced.

OpeningSubmitted.description: The command OpenEpoch, whole, as the store adapter hands it to the writer.

StoreEpochOpened.description: Hidden truth: the epoch the ledger holds as opened, and the attempt that opened it, once durable.

OpeningReplyDelivered.description: The reply to an OpenEpoch the core consumed: the whole command it answers and its outcome. A committed reply names the epoch, a rejected one its reason.

OpeningAbandoned.description: Start-up stopped waiting for the reply of this attempt. Not terminal: the reply is still honoured if it arrives before a new submission.

EpochGrantHandedOver.description: The grant of an opened epoch moved to the creator of owners.

StepBlocked.description: The bench stopped the run before its last step: at `step`, of kind `step_kind`, because no action was eligible and the awaited event had not happened (`quiescent`), or because the budget of steps ran out (`budget`). For diagnosis only, what still waited at the stop: `armed_deadlines`, the deadlines armed and not fired, and `holding_faults`, the faults that still hold an item. The verdict depends on `cause` alone.
